svg.title: Plutto: ask your own birth chart, out loud
svg.desc: Website hero: wordmark top left, headline, subhead and an outlined button on the left; on the right the gold orb inside a faint natal wheel.
svg.text: Plutto is an astrology oracle you talk to. It reads your
chart in plain words, in the tradition you choose.
Vedic, Western, Chinese, KP or numerology. Interrupt it,
or switch traditions mid-sentence. Your memory is kept.
